Generated Narrative: CodeSystem oligo-nucleotide-type

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/oligo-nucleotide-type defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
antisense Antisense oligonucleotideAn antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) that binds to a complementary mRNA sequence to inhibit gene expression.
sirna Small interfering RNA (siRNA)A short double-stranded RNA that triggers degradation of a target mRNA through the RNA interference pathway.
mirna MicroRNA (miRNA)A short non-coding RNA that regulates gene expression by base-pairing with target mRNAs.
aptamer AptamerA short single-stranded oligonucleotide that binds a specific target through its three-dimensional structure.
decoy Decoy oligonucleotideAn oligonucleotide that mimics a regulatory binding site to sequester a transcription factor or other binding protein.
ribozyme Ribozyme / DNAzymeA catalytic oligonucleotide capable of cleaving a target nucleic acid.
gene-fragment Gene fragmentA fragment of a gene such as a promoter, enhancer, coding region or silencer.
